title: Target anatomy
view: Section of the right supraclavicular fossa in the plane of the probe (parallel to the clavicle, aimed caudally), seen from the feet as on ultrasound: lateral on the image left, medial on the right.
teachingPoint: Plexus lateral and superficial to the subclavian artery, which rests on the first rib; needle in-plane from lateral, passing deep to the plexus to the corner pocket above the rib; pleura deep to the rib and medial to the artery.
claims: Right supraclavicular fossa in section, lateral on the left, as on ultrasound (house laterality).
Plexus lateral and superficial to the subclavian artery; the artery rests on the first rib (record subtitle).
Pleura deep to the rib and medial to the artery (record subtitle); the lung beneath it is standard anatomy added here.

Middle scalene lateral and deep to the plexus, anterior scalene medial to the artery inserting on the rib, subclavian vein medial to it, SCM clavicular head at the medial edge: standard anatomy added here.
Needle in-plane from lateral, deep to the plexus, tip in the corner pocket: deep to the plexus, superficial to the rib, lateral to the artery (record steps 6).
Teal: the corner-pocket injection under the plexus (record step 8).
Labels: Brachial plexus, Subclavian artery, Middle scalene, First rib, Pleura.
